name: DeviceLab
title: Device Lab

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Device Lab shows your location on the map and measures distances to nearby trails.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Device Lab checks camera permission to show how apps ask before using the camera.

about: Device features, with trail examples: asking for permission, Core Location, MapKit maps, search and routes, CloudKit, photos and sharing, the on-device language model, and widgets, App Intents, a Live Activity and local notifications.
notes: Set a location in the Simulator with Features > Location.
The language model, the camera and Siri need a real iPhone. Without them the app explains what would happen and never crashes.
CloudKit runs in a labeled simulated mode and the widget shows a stand-in count: both need capabilities from the paid Apple Developer Program.
